title: Qualify Orabona Example2.25 full normal-cone equalities
head: codex/research-online-normal-cone-migration
body:
Orabona Example2.25 now has a current source-qualified acceptance packet for all three normal-cone equalities: full indicator support at every query including outside emptiness; the whole cone {0} at ambient interior points; and the complete nonnegative radial ray, including zero, at every boundary point of the closed unit ball. The retained proofs derive feasibility, the interior contradiction and radiality from actual inputs. THREE retained proofs and ONE complete retained normal definition represent ONE body example; zero new mathematical or TEST declarations.

This PR stacks on OPEN draft #171 at exact 9cb6dc7f111f2d1c4925cfbfb3d29b9410f2bc0d. Changes are an ordinary leading source/scope comment preserving every original raw mathematical byte, selected normal reader content and versioned source/contract/evidence/manifest. Four frozen headers, full owned normal definition, borrowed support/indicator/properness/domain APIs, whole four canary proofs and two real2D basis definitions, shared roots/toolchain/dependencies are preserved. The definition itself has NO finite-dimension/nonempty/convexity premise; all three theorem signatures retain finite dimension and the first two retain nonempty convex V. No general closed/bounded V, relative-interior replacement, supplied radiality, positive-dimension or extra completeness premise.

The shared global supporting predicate accepts improper EReal functions beyond the printed proper-function definition. Nonempty V produces properness of the zero/top indicator and makes this source instance faithful. Empty V is excluded: generic support of all-top can contain every vector while the feasible normal set is empty. The coordinate-free finite-dimensional real inner-product presentation includes the source Euclidean instances; no separately certified coordinate isometry/functor, algorithm/regret/probability or vector-selection guarantee.

Distinct formalizer, restricted neutral decoder and anti-anchored source reviewer completed CONTRACT/BODYv2/FINAL under requested GPT-6 Astra/medium, with honest prior-history disclosure. These are automated roles, not human/external review or attested runtime model provenance. The reader preserves three original curated routes, exactly three notation entries and four existing canonical links including the full definition. All10811 shared registry IDs/URLs remain, zero new per-Book nodes. Actual two-dimensional canary accepts outward2e0 and zero, rejects transverse e1 and inward -e0. The singleton canary proves full support and7, not empty interior itself.
